name: v23_benefit_stockcomp_competitor_mix
hypothesis: Employee-benefit liabilities and share-based compensation are labor/compensation overhangs that may be distinct from prepaid/tax and buyback quality; competitor authority is only a moderate stabilizer.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry)
notes: Avoids ROE/EPS/CFO/close-open/tax/prepaid; strict corr gate against d5xj5W5v and pw6jz8ob.

name: v23_benefit_debt_maturity_partner_mix
hypothesis: Lower employee-benefit liabilities and lower near-term debt maturities reduce obligation pressure; partner breadth is used as a relationship breadth stabilizer rather than centrality.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_maturities_repayments_next12m / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Tests a liability-pressure composite without competitor/customer authority centrality.

name: v23_stockcomp_debt_event_competitor_mix
hypothesis: Share-based compensation burden and debt extinguishment events are separate accounting overhangs; mixing them may lift v17 near-misses without using aqi/CFO/reversal.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry)
notes: No fnd6_aqi boost; checks whether two weak accounting families combine cleanly.

name: v23_acquired_goodwill_benefit_partner
hypothesis: Recently acquired goodwill is an acquisition-accounting burden different from goodwill stock; combine it with benefit liabilities and partner breadth to avoid the known goodwill-stock clone.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * acquired_goodwill_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Sparse acquisition-goodwill field; watch concentrated-weight and sub-universe checks.

name: v23_goodwill_growth_benefit_competitor_low_weight
hypothesis: Goodwill growth has strong raw signal but high correlation; keep it at 30% and let benefit liabilities plus competitor authority dominate the ranking path.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(goodwill, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry)
notes: Attempts to reuse goodwill-growth strength without cloning RRp7Q9Le/mL8j98w9/MPpGzqwr.

name: v23_lease_benefit_competitor_low_weight
hypothesis: Lease burden had acceptable metrics but cloned prepaid/tax; reduce lease to 30% and pair it with benefit liabilities and competitor authority.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_minimum_operating_lease_payments / assets, 126), industry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry)
notes: Designed specifically to test whether lease can be rescued as an auxiliary instead of a main signal.

name: v23_hump_benefit_stockcomp_debt
hypothesis: Hump smoothing may change the update path of several low-turnover accounting near-misses enough to improve Fitness and correlation behavior.
expression: hump(0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry))
notes: Operator test from Learn notes; if syntax or metrics fail, do not keep expanding hump blindly.

name: v23_trade_when_quiet_volume_lease
hypothesis: The lease signal may be less correlated when refreshed only in quieter volume regimes, instead of continuously behaving like prepaid/tax liability quality.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20) < 0.5, group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_minimum_operating_lease_payments / assets, 126), industry), -1)
notes: trade_when syntax was validated in v20; this tests it on a strong but high-correlation slow signal.

name: v23_trade_when_quiet_return_tax_goodwill
hypothesis: Deferred-tax allowance and goodwill growth are strong but high-correlation materials; refresh them only during low absolute-return regimes to alter PnL timing.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.6, 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * deferred_tax_assets_valuation_allowance_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(goodwill, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry), -1)
notes: A deliberate high-correlation-material rescue; submit only if local daily-return correlation clears.

name: v23_ifelse_graph_condition_benefit_stockcomp
hypothesis: Use benefit-liability burden for high competitor-authority firms and stock-comp burden otherwise, creating a conditional accounting signal rather than a linear near-neighbor.
expression: if_else(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60) > 0.5, group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry), group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry))
notes: if_else operator test; intended to alter the cross-sectional path rather than merely average two weak fields.
